summary: Configured and verified the PostgreSQL HA cluster across the two routed LANs. node2 is the sole primary; node3 and node4 are streaming replicas with appdb data present.
actions_performed: Saved VyOS routing and HA-only inter-LAN firewall rules
Configured persistent static LAN addresses and host routes
Installed and enabled etcd and Patroni with reboot ordering
Created appdb, appuser, and replicated appdata
Enabled host access controls for only required HA ports
Generated credentials on managed nodes without exposing them
Verified HA services, replication, routing, and denied management/SSH access
